REx: Reincarnated is a mining game about finding rare and stunning ores, ranging from one in 25 to chances in the billions. Craft countless pickaxes and gears to work your way up the power scale, using abilities that hollow tunnels, summon spirits, and create black holes to help you mine blocks!
